topic: Light: from an oil lamp to an LED bulb

episode.title: Evolution of Light: Oil Flame to LED Glow

shots.scene: Clean studio product photograph of one ancient terracotta oil lamp, centred and upright, spout pointing right, viewed at a fixed three-quarter angle at object height. Plain charcoal gradient background, soft upper-left lighting, subtle floor shadow, vertical 9:16 composition. No people, text, letter
shots.action: Show a recognisable rounded clay reservoir with a short exposed wick and a small warm flame. Keep the entire lamp visible with generous space around it.

shots.scene: Clean studio product photograph of one kerosene lamp, centred and upright, viewed at the same fixed three-quarter angle at object height. Plain charcoal gradient background, soft upper-left lighting, subtle floor shadow, vertical 9:16 composition. Match the previous shot's framing and visual centre.
shots.action: Replace the open clay lamp with a clear fuel reservoir and tall glass chimney enclosing a small warm flame. Make the protective glass enclosure the defining visual change.

shots.scene: Clean studio product photograph of one early carbon-filament incandescent light bulb, centred and upright with screw base downward, viewed at the same fixed three-quarter angle at object height. Plain charcoal gradient background, soft upper-left lighting, subtle floor shadow, vertical 9:16 composit
shots.action: Replace the fuel-burning lamp with a clear pear-shaped electric bulb containing a visibly glowing carbon-filament loop. Make the enclosed electric filament the defining visual change.

shots.scene: Clean studio product photograph of one clear tungsten-filament incandescent light bulb, centred and upright with screw base downward, viewed at the same fixed three-quarter angle at object height. Plain charcoal gradient background, soft upper-left lighting, subtle floor shadow, vertical 9:16 compos
shots.action: Change only the internal light source from a broad carbon loop to a fine supported tungsten filament glowing warm white.

shots.scene: Clean studio product photograph of one early compact fluorescent light bulb, centred and upright with screw base downward, viewed at the same fixed three-quarter angle at object height. Plain charcoal gradient background, soft upper-left lighting, subtle floor shadow, vertical 9:16 composition. Matc
shots.action: Replace the filament-filled glass envelope with folded white fluorescent tubes rising from a plain ballast housing. Make the folded glowing tube the defining visual change.

shots.scene: Clean studio product photograph of one contemporary LED light bulb, centred and upright with screw base downward, viewed at the same fixed three-quarter angle at object height. shots.action: Replace the exposed fluorescent tubes with a seamless frosted dome on a compact matte-white housing. Give the dome a beautifully even warm-white glow with controlled highlights for an impressive final reveal.

episode.endHook: Which era had the best-looking light?
episode.description: From a flickering oil lamp to a brilliant LED bulb, watch everyday lighting transform through the ages. #EvolutionOf #LightingHistory #LED #ThenAndNow #Shorts
